en: The postcard features three monochrome images: a church with a tower and adjacent street scene, a medieval round gate tower with half-timbered buildings, and a grand baroque-style palace. The captions in German under each image read 'Kirche u. Tor.' (church and gate), 'Torturm.' (gate tower), and 'Fürstl. Schloss.' (princely palace). The central text says 'Gruss aus Langenburg' (Greetings from Langenburg). Publisher information is at the bottom.
